key_insight: ResNet50 feature extraction combined with Random Forest classification can detect orbital TIG welding defects with high accuracy and strong robustness.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports faster, more reliable weld quality inspection for precision manufacturing where defect misclassification can compromise structural integrity.
method: Extract deep visual features from weld images using ResNet50.
Classify defect types with a Random Forest model.
Evaluate performance with five-fold cross-validation across four weld classes.
evidence_signal: Using 3,219 weld images, the method achieved 98% overall accuracy and outperformed VGG16, VGG19, ResNet18, ResNet50, SVM, and standalone Random Forest baselines.
watch_item: Performance was demonstrated on controlled experimental images, so generalization to different welding setups, lighting conditions, or unseen defect patterns still needs validation.
paper_title: TIG welding defect detection using ResNet and Random Forest
